correctness.rationale: In the measurement row Gram matrix the two diagonal blocks are identities and the cross block is the measured Fourier submatrix or its adjoint. A block SVD gives the spectrum 1 and 1±s_j, with s_j²=1−h_j by unitarity and h_j the eigenvalues of the omitted 3×3 Fourier Gram matrix. Both objectives therefore depend monotonically on its least eigenvalue. Independently evaluated every pair of labelled triples using Cauchy–Binet sums of squared 2×2 minors and a squared 3×3 determinant via integer autocorrelations of permutation exponents modulo 7. Positive determinant certifies invertibility for every design. Sign enclosures using 6/5<u<5/4 separate all 1078 losing pairs by negative shifted determinant and all 147 winners by positive leading minors of 5G−7I. Reconstructed seven disjoint affine orbits and checked that the only winning orbit is exactly the pairs of AP triples with step product ±2, using the omitted triple, not the measured four-set. The winning invariants tr G=9, e₂(G)=22+3u and det G=14+7u give the stated cubic and constants after normalizing G=7H. The apparent 'six or seven' wording in the scope paragraph is immaterial to the expressly fixed 3+4 experiment.
residual_risks: The exact computation is exhaustive only for Z₇ at the declared sample split; no weighted or larger-order claim was checked.
